summary:
Successfully implemented KAFKA-20444: Aligned TxnOffsetCommit API with OffsetCommit API (KIP-1319) by adding topic ID support to both TxnOffsetCommitRequest and TxnOffsetCommitResponse while maintaining backward compatibility. All 26 relevant tests pass.

Changes made:
1. TxnOffsetCommitRequest: Updated getErrorResponseTopics() and getErrorResponse() to include topic IDs in error responses
2. TxnOffsetCommitResponse: Added newBuilder(boolean useTopicIds) factory method, created TopicIdBuilder class for topic ID-based indexing, updated Builder class to support both topic IDs and names, and maintained backward compatibility with overloaded addPartition method

Test results: ✅ TxnOffsetCommitRequestTest (18 tests pass), ✅ TxnOffsetCommitResponseTest (8 tests pass), ✅ OffsetCommit tests pass (backward compatibility verified)
